locale_en.c25.ai_prompt:
You are an assistant who helps propose keywords that fit a website.
The reader is a freelance SEO person who wants to put keyword ideas for a client site into a proposal.

# About the data
- Date: {date}
- Country and language: {country} / {language}
- Rows: {n}
- Columns
  - Keyword: a candidate estimated to fit the site (domain) I entered.
  - Monthly searches: an estimate based on Google Ads data. Blank means "no data", not necessarily zero.
  - CPC (USD): the average price per click for advertisers. It is not the value of an article.
  - Competition (0-100): how competitive the keyword is for ads. It is not SEO difficulty.
- This is not data about where the site actually ranks for these keywords.

# What I would like you to do
1. Group the keywords into 3-5 themes.
2. Pick 10 keywords to target first. Look at searches and competition, and give reasons with numbers.
3. Outline a proposal to give the client, with headings only (up to 5 items).
4. Briefly say what cannot be known from the data alone (for example, the current ranking or results).

# Rules
- Use only the numbers I gave you. Do not make up numbers.
- Say "this is a guess" when you guess.
- Write short and simple, so that a middle-school student can understand.
- Finish with a table (keyword / monthly searches / competition / reason).

C25.content_en:
Ways to get keyword ideas for a website — and how the main tools compare

When you take over a client's site, you first want a list of keywords related to that site. Enter a domain and this tool lists the keywords Google associates with it, with monthly volume, CPC and competition.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. $0.09 per call (measured)From a domain: keyword ideas with volume, CPC and competition. Up to nearly 1000 rows per call (our target.com sample shows the first 60). Save as CSV
Google Keyword Planner (by hand)Needs a Google Ads account (see the official site for costs)Has a feature that suggests ideas from a site URL (see the official site for features and limits)
Ahrefs Site Explorer / Keywords ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)Strong at the keywords a site actually ranks for
UbersuggestSubscription and one-time options are advertised (prices differ by source; see the official site)Site analysis and keyword ideas

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • A domain is enough. Type it as "example.com".
  • Up to about 1000 rows in one call. A Japanese shopping site returned 998 in one test (measured in Japan); the target.com sample shows 60. One call costs $0.09 either way.
  • Volume, CPC and competition included. Useful for prioritizing ideas.
  • A few seconds. We measured about 5–8 seconds (7.5 s for target.com).
  • Save as CSV. Filter in a spreadsheet.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want the rankings the site actually holds → these are Google Ads keyword ideas, not the site's rankings.
  • You find too many rows → all rows are shown. The page gets long; export to CSV and filter in a spreadsheet.
  • What competition means → the competition column is Google Ads competition (0–100), not SEO difficulty.
  • Some rows have no CPC → every one of the 60 target.com sample rows had a CPC, but a Japanese shopping site had 140 blank rows out of 998 (measured in Japan). Blanks stay blank.
  • Brand and product names (brand searches) mix in as they come.
  • Some domains return 0 rows → in an earlier test on a Japanese real-estate site (suumo.jp, measured in Japan) it returned none, and the call still cost $0.09.

This tool does one thing: list keyword ideas related to a domain, with their volume.

FAQ

Are these the keywords the site ranks for?

No. They are Google Ads keyword ideas, not the site's rankings.

Why so many rows?

We show every row the API returns. You cannot choose the count.

Why do brand names and loose phrases mix in?

Words related to the site appear as they are. For target.com the top rows include "target store", "target near me" and "target online shopping".

What does a blank CPC mean?

The API returned no value for that row. We leave it blank.

Am I charged when there are 0 rows?

Yes. In an earlier test on a Japanese real-estate site (suumo.jp, measured in Japan) it returned no rows but cost $0.09.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C26.content_en:
Ways to find keywords for ads — and how the main tools compare

You want to run ads for your shop but do not know which words to bid on. Enter one keyword and this tool lists related keyword ideas with monthly volume, CPC and competition.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. $0.09 per call (measured)From one keyword: related ideas with volume, CPC and competition (60 rows in our "ramen new york" sample). Save as CSV
Google Keyword Planner (by hand)Free (needs a Google Ads account)Has a feature that suggests ideas from keywords (see the official site). A screen advertisers use
SemrushFree plan available; paid plans are subscriptions (see the official site for prices)A keyword research suite (see the official site for features and limits)
UbersuggestSubscription and one-time options are advertised (prices differ by source; see the official site)Keyword ideas and light analysis

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • One keyword grows into many ideas. "ramen new york" returned 60 rows in our U.S. sample (12,100 searches a month for the seed phrase). Earlier Japanese tests returned 80 and 191 rows (measured in Japan).
  • Place-name phrases appear. Find words around your shop, such as "ramen nyc" or "momo ramen brooklyn" in our sample.
  • Volume, CPC and competition included. A guide to words worth bidding on.
  • A few seconds. We measured about 4 seconds (3.95 s for the sample).
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want a cost estimate for ads → CPC is a per-click guide in US dollars. Real cost depends on how you run the ads.
  • You want to choose the count → every returned row is shown.
  • What competition means → the competition column is Google Ads competition (0–100), not SEO difficulty.
  • Loosely related words (such as other shop names, like "jin ramen uws") mix in.
  • Some rows have no CPC → 18 of the 60 sample rows. They stay blank.
  • You want to limit it to the area around your shop → it works at country level; you cannot narrow to a city or ward. Put the place name into the keyword instead.
  • The numbers are advertising data, separate from real ad results.

This tool does one thing: list the keywords related to one keyword.

FAQ

Why do other shop names appear?

We show the words Google associates, unfiltered.

What unit is CPC in?

US dollars, a per-click guide.

What do country and language change?

The market the numbers refer to. The U.S. and English give U.S. volumes; Japan and Japanese give Japanese volumes.

Can I enter several keywords?

This tool takes one. For several at once, "see search volume" fits better.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
